newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hysan Dev eases after results.
newsitem.headline: Hysan Dev eases after results.

text.p: Shares of Hysan Development Co Ltd drifted lower on Wednesday afternoon after the company announced a 10.12 percent growth in its net profit to HK$1.35 billion for calendar 1996, brokers said.
"The profit is slightly lower than the market expected but nobody expected too much from property investors," said Antony Mak at Vickers Ballas.

Analysts had forecast Hysan would report about a 13 percent rise in net profit to between HK$1.36 billion and HK$1.41 billion. Shares of Hysan dipped to a low of HK$24.35, before steadying at HK$24.50, down HK$0.75, or 2.97 percent.
Brokers said speculative buying during the morning session pushed the counter to a high of HK$25.25 before the results were announced.
But prices moved lower on a lack of follow-through buying.
"We see no major selling pressure in the counter, the price fall is just in line with the whole market," said Antony Mak.
A total of 3.06 million shares worth HK$75.31 million were traded in late afternoon.
